method: built-in image_gen; one individual standing sprite per source orientation
scope: Five neutral standing frames only; existing 40 walking images are preserved.

entries.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: one full-body neutral standing game sprite, south/front view, for the existing Caatuu walking demo.
Input image 1 is the character, art style, proportions and front camera reference. Regenerate this exact macaw as a NEW genuine motionless standing pose. Keep the turquoise head and wing hands, cream face patches, large golden hooked beak, dark eyes, gray feather beard, golden bird feet with dark claws, and the same ochre brown hooded robe tied with a fabric belt. Keep the same clean hand-drawn cartoon linework and cel shading; no added backpack, accessories or scenery.
Pose: face directly toward the viewer; head and torso upright and level; both arms/wing hands relaxed straight down at the sides, not swinging and not reaching. Both feet planted flat beside one another at the same resting depth, with equal weight; no raised heel, lifted foot, staggered stride, bent marching leg or forward lean. This must read immediately as standing still rather than a paused walking frame.
Composition: one complete centered character on a square canvas with generous transparent margins, all beak, tail feathers, hands, toes and claws fully inside the image. Camera matches the supplied reference, not top-down. Retain the character identity and outfit closely.
Background: genuine transparent alpha. Regenerate clean crisp silhouette edges without pink or coral spill, fringe or colored halos. No ground plane, no shadow or glow, no text or labels, no checkerboard drawn into pixels. Output only this ONE south-facing standing sprite.

Input image 1 is the exact camera angle and character silhouette authority for this direction. Input image 2 is the newly regenerated SOUTH standing sprite and supplies the neutral posture, clean linework and outfit detail; do NOT copy its front camera view.
Primary request: regenerate the same macaw from image 1 into a genuinely motionless standing pose, keeping the character identity, head size, anatomy, turquoise feathers and wing hands, cream face patches where visible, large golden hooked beak where visible, dark eyes where visible, gray feather beard where visible, golden bird feet and dark claws, and ochre brown hooded robe tied with a fabric belt. Same clean hand-drawn cartoon/cel-shaded style, not pixel art, not 3D. No new backpack or accessories.
Camera requirement: NORTH: exact straight rear view. See only the back of the turquoise head, back of the brown hood and robe, two relaxed arms at the sides, turquoise tail below the rear robe, and the rear-facing feet planted at rest. NO eye, face patches, beard or beak visible. Head and shoulders symmetric; no head turn.
Neutral pose: upright, relaxed, balanced torso and level head; both feet firmly resting on the same ground plane with equal weight; both arms/wing hands relaxed down. No lifted foot, heel lift, bent marching knee, forward movement lean, stride or arm swing. Keep the visible toes anatomically clear and avoid fused limbs.
Composition: one complete centered character on a square canvas with generous empty alpha margin around every extremity. All beak, tail, toes, claws and hands inside the canvas. Similar overall body proportions to reference 1 so stopping does not visibly change the character. Output only ONE sprite, no sheet or additional views.
Background: genuine transparent alpha. Clean regenerated silhouette and dark outlines, no pink/coral contamination, fringe, colored halo, background, floor, cast shadow, glow, text, labels, borders or checkerboard pixels.
